info.name: CarePoint CAPQ - Clinic Appointment and Patient Queue REST API
info.description:
Comprehensive REST API collection for CarePoint Clinic Appointment & Patient Queue (CAPQ) System.

### Tech Stack
- Backend: Native PHP (PHP 7.4 / 8.x)
- Database: MySQL 8.0 / MariaDB with automatic demo-mode fallback
- Protocol: RESTful JSON over HTTP

### Included Modules
1. Appointments Management (Booking, Reference Tracking, List)
2. Queue Management (Walk-in Issue, Live State, Doctor Call, Finish Consultation, Skip)
3. Doctors Directory (Doctor profiles, Specialties, Queue load)
4. Analytics & KPIs (Dashboard metrics, Wait times, Department load)
